youtube_full.title: Break Up the Hard Ground | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Hosea 10:12
youtube_full.description:
Break Up the Hard Ground: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Hosea 10:12.

Hosea’s people were farmers who had stopped listening to Heavenly Father. So He used a farming picture.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Beau the Brave.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: Break Up the Hard Ground
1:11 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Beau the Brave
1:46 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:56 Question time
3:14 Sweet dreams
3:32 More stories, the app and the paperback
